meta.title: Reject button opens the reject email
gaps: Sign in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval request email
Click the Reject button in the email
Assert that the subject starts with the exact prefix "Action:Reject|Proposal:[" rather than merely containing "Action:Reject"
Assert that the comment reason area contains an empty line
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval request email; Click the Reject button in the email; Assert that the subject starts with the exact prefix "Action:Reject|Proposal:[" rather than merely containing "Action:Reject"; Assert that the comment reason area contains an empty line

args.need: sign in to Asha's mailbox, open the Procol approval request email, click Reject, and leave the newly opened rejection email visible

steps.note: Mailbox access and clicking the email's Reject action are not available in the catalog.
Checks that the resulting email subject contains the rejection action prefix.
Checks that the rejection email includes the required comment prompt.
